content_of_post_to_comment: I’m looking for writers who are more interested in telling the truth than sounding impressive. Not polished. Not perfect. Not algorithmically optimized. Human. If you wrote something this week that says something real, drop it below. I want to read it.
comment: There’s an interesting tension between truth and craft: sometimes polishing a piece reveals the truth more clearly, and sometimes it hides the messy parts that make it human. The challenge is knowing which is which.
